title: Boing! My Ball Goes Up! 🔴 Up and Down with Baby Jimmy | Learn Opposites | Crayon Babies
description:
Boing! Baby Jimmy's shiny red ball bounces UP… and comes DOWN! Sing, stretch and pat along with Jimmy in this bouncy review song about up and down.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🔴 "Wow! Boing! My ball goes up!"
🙌 Up, up, up! Hands up high – stretch up with Jimmy!
⬇️ Down it comes! Hands down low – pat, pat, pat!
🎵 Up and down! Up and down! Boing, boing!
🤔 "Is my ball up or down?" – shout the answer: UP! It's up high!
👋 Up and down! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: opposites up and down • up = high • down = low • up • down • high • low • ball

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun opposites sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy plays with a red ball on the rainbow rug in the living room, stretches his arms up high when the ball goes up, pats the floor down low when it comes down, and asks little viewers to answer "up or down?".
